grammar.title: Not only... but also with 不光...还/也
grammar.pattern: 不光 + A，(主语) + 还/也 + B
grammar.explanation: 不光 (bùguāng) is a casual, spoken way to say "not only" — just like 不但 and 不仅, it pairs with 还 or 也 in the next clause to add more information.

grammar.title: Nearly, close to with 将近
grammar.explanation: 将近 (jiāngjìn) means "nearly, close to" — it goes right before a number, showing the real amount is just short of it. It's often used for quantities, distances, or lengths of time.

sentences.zh: 他不光会说汉语，还会说英语。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bùguāng huì shuō Hànyǔ, hái huì shuō Yīngyǔ.
sentences.en: He can speak not only Chinese, but also English.

sentences.zh: 这个地方不光漂亮，还很安静。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège dìfang bùguāng piàoliang, hái hěn ānjìng.
sentences.en: This place is not only pretty, but also quiet.

sentences.pinyin: Tā bùguāng rènzhēn, hái hěn nǔlì.
sentences.en: She's not only conscientious, but also hardworking.

sentences.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò jiāngjìn yī nián le.
sentences.en: This job has lasted nearly a year.

sentences.zh: 将近一百人参加了这次比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Jiāngjìn yī bǎi rén cānjiā le zhè cì bǐsài.
sentences.en: Nearly a hundred people took part in this competition.
